name: slugify
description: A pure string function with normalisation, truncation and a fallback.

files.textkit/slug.py:
"""URL slugs from titles."""

import re
import unicodedata

_NON_WORD = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")


def slugify(title: str, max_length: int = 50) -> str:
    """Lowercase ASCII words joined by '-', at most ``max_length`` characters."""
    if max_length < 1:
        raise ValueError("max_length must be at least 1")
    ascii_text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode()
    slug = _NON_WORD.sub("-", ascii_text.lower()).strip("-")
    if len(slug) > max_length:
        slug = slug[:max_length].rstrip("-")
    return slug or "untitled"
